changelog:
- Initial release of the seo-programmatic skill for planning and analyzing programmatic SEO at scale.
- Supports best practices for template engines, URL patterns, internal linking, thin content prevention, and index bloat management.
- Built-in quality gates and content uniqueness checks to comply with scaled content abuse guidelines.
- Includes strategies for canonical tags, sitemap integration, and data source assessment.
- Provides an SEO scoring and summary framework for audits and ongoing optimization.
summary: Programmatic SEO planning and analysis for pages generated at scale from data sources. Covers template engines, URL patterns, internal linking automation, thin content safeguards, and index bloat prevention. Use when user says "programmatic SEO", "pages at scale", "dynamic pages", "template pages", "generated pages", or "data-driven SEO".
